provenance.direction: The user chose 'the category standard' in black and white (the standing exit / canon path, not a concept roll), in another session. It replaces the earlier petrol + maravilla direction from the three-way debate; nothing of that world carries forward.
provenance.brandCommitment: Interfaz en blanco y negro; verde solo para lo positivo, rojo solo para alertas (asked for explicitly by the user).
provenance.build: Tokens and rules read from index.html (published as version 7 of the claude.ai artifact). index.antes-bn.html was consulted as evidence of the change only.

additionalTokens.name: accent
additionalTokens.purpose: Today's bar and day number in the rail.

additionalTokens.name: on-accent
additionalTokens.purpose: Declared counterpart of --accent; not used by any rule in the build.

additionalTokens.name: ring
additionalTokens.purpose: Focus outline and caret; white (--on-shell) inside the band.

display.purpose: Hero money figure in the black band.

figure-input.purpose: Amount field in the logging sheet; the $ sign is 32px muted at the same weight and width.

headline.purpose: Band title on Movimientos, Categorías and the empty state.

title.purpose: Page section headings (18px); sheet and dialog headings use 19px.

amount.purpose: Movement amounts; category totals use the same width and weight at body size.

label.purpose: Field labels, day headers, table headers, legend; tab labels are 12px.

shadows.name: floating-action
shadows.purpose: The black + button in the bottom bar.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The context menu growing from its trigger.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Presses, menu, toast, dialog, rail and bar growth.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Segmented thumb (240ms) and tab clip-path indicator (220ms).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile sheet slide-up (420ms open, 260ms close); drag the head down to dismiss.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: All buttons on press; the + uses .93, movement rows .985.

motion.name: hold-to-delete
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0) over 1.2s linear; release springs back in 200ms ease-out

motion.name: rail-grow
motion.value: scaleY from 0, 520ms ease-out, 22ms stagger per day + 80ms
motion.purpose: Rail bars on first load only; meters and category bars grow with scaleX 700ms after 200ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Entrance animations removed (page fades), sheet and toast fade without translate, press scales and sliding indicators disabled.

breakpoints.name: desktop-sheet
breakpoints.purpose: Sheet becomes a centered 540px floating card; drag handle hidden.

breakpoints.name: content-max
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of band and page content.

breakpoints.name: tabbar-max
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of the bottom bar's tab grid.

narrative.overview:
Tablero de Dinero is a black-and-white money tool. The user chose "the category standard" in black and white: the standing exit, the canon path of personal-finance apps, not a rolled concept. That choice was made in another session and replaced the earlier petrol direction that came out of the three-way debate; nothing from the petrol world (petrol band, maravilla accent, per-category colors) carries forward. The brand commitment the user asked for in so many words is the governing rule of this file: "Interfaz en blanco y negro; verde solo para lo positivo, rojo solo para alertas".

The screen has three bands. A black top band holds the answer: "Te quedan", the figure, the per-day line, the Entró/Salió pills and the quincena rail. Below it, a plain white page that starts flush under the band (no overlap, no rounded top corners) holds sections separated by hairlines. At the bottom, a white tab bar with a top border and a black + in the middle. Density is calm and phone-first, with a single 720px column on desktop.

Color is reserved for meaning. Everything structural is ink, white or grey; green appears only where money comes in, and red only where something is wrong (negative balance, overspending, deleting). Spending is ink, never red. Motion carries the craft that color no longer does: a drawer sheet you can drag down, a hold-to-delete fill, a clip-path tab indicator, a sliding segmented control, an undo toast, and the rail growing on first load.
keyCharacteristics: Black top band, white page, white bottom bar; strict achromatic structure.
Green only for income, red only for alerts; spending stays ink.
Categories are told apart by their initial in a grey tile, not by color.
Archivo throughout, widened (wdth 118, weight 800) for money figures; tabular numerals everywhere.
Flat surfaces; shadow only on the floating + and the context menu.
Motion is functional and fully covered by reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The Two Hues Rule
rules.body: The interface is black and white. Green appears only for income, red only for alerts. No third hue, no decorative tint, no brand accent.

rules.name: The Spending Is Ink Rule
rules.body: An expense is never red. Red means a problem (negative, overspending) or a destructive act. Expense amounts, bars and the expense trend line are ink.

rules.name: The Initial, Not Color Rule
rules.body: Categories have no color in the interface. A category is marked by its uppercase initial in a 36px Fog tile; the letter turns Income Green for income categories. Do not reintroduce swatches, color pickers or colored dots.

rules.name: The Wide Money Rule
rules.body: Money figures are Archivo at wdth 110-118 and weight 700-800; prose never is.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: The body sets `tabular-nums`, so every amount aligns in columns and does not jitter while typing.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only the + button and the context menu carry shadow, and both are soft and blurred. Cards, sections and the bottom bar stay flat; the bar separates with a hairline.

dos: **Do** keep every structural element in ink, Paper, Fog, Graphite Text or hairline; use green only for income and red only for alerts.
**Do** mark categories with their initial in a Fog tile; turn the letter green for income.
**Do** use the band-tuned variants (Band Green, Band Red) for color on the black band.
**Do** set money in Archivo at wdth 110-118, weight 700-800, with tabular numerals.
**Do** make primary actions ink with Paper text, and the selected chip ink-filled.
**Do** give every animation a reduced-motion fallback (fade or none), as the build does.
donts: **Don't** color an expense red; red is for negative, overspending and deleting.
**Don't** show category colors anywhere in the interface: no swatches, dots, colored bars or "Cambiar color".
**Don't** add a brand accent hue, tint the band, or reintroduce petrol or maravilla.
**Don't** overlap the page onto the band or round the page's top corners.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, sections or the bottom bar; only the + and the context menu float.
**Don't** decorate with Ecuadorian folk imagery (flags, volcanoes, sucres); the local character lives in the quincena logic and the language.
